commits.subject: feat(design-release-2-1-consignment-parties): Every save control on the county parish holding, permanent address and contact address pages makes the same checks
test(design-release-2-1-consignment-parties): Party and CPH number browser tests share the journey's save step and prove looks without class lists
feat(design-release-2-1-consignment-parties): The address book takes adds from germinal products notifications and returns to them
feat(design-release-2-1-consignment-parties): The CPH, permanent address and contact pages' endings, with no cancel control while amending, and the contact page's hub wording
feat(design-release-2-1-consignment-parties): The roles and addresses page shows a permanent address where one is needed, and its task completes only when every section shown does
feat(design-release-2-1-consignment-parties): The contact address page offers only the trader's own branch addresses and adds a new branch through the address book
feat(design-release-2-1-consignment-parties): The contact address page says whose address it is and requires a choice
feat(design-release-2-1-consignment-parties): The consignment addresses and review pages show the county parish holding number as 12/345/6789
feat(design-release-2-1-consignment-parties): The county parish holding number page: who is asked, its help and hint, a blank save, and where it goes
feat(design-release-2-1-consignment-parties): High-risk plants pickers' address lines and trimmed details disclosure
feat(design-release-2-1-consignment-parties): Same-as shortcuts on the roles and addresses page
feat(design-release-2-1-consignment-parties): Role-filtered party pickers on one page

scenarios.heading: The contact address page refuses either save control with nothing chosen while amending

steps.text: the contact address page of a notification being amended, with no address chosen
the user selects "Save and continue" or "Save and return to hub"
they stay on the page, which shows the error that a contact address must be selected
nothing is saved

scenarios.heading: Save and return to hub also saves the chosen address and opens Overview

steps.text: the user is on the contact address page
they choose an address and save and return to hub
the answer is saved and no error summary is shown
Overview is shown
they return to the contact address page
the same address is shown chosen in the list

scenarios.heading: A held contact address is not shown chosen once its record is no longer offered or its details were changed here

steps.text: the notification holds a contact address copied from a record the organisation's book no longer offers, or whose details were edited on the notification
the user opens the contact address page
no address is shown as chosen
the organisation's remaining addresses are offered
the notification keeps the contact address it holds

scenarios.heading: While amending, a save with nothing chosen is refused the same way, with the addresses offered again and none chosen

steps.text: a notification being amended whose held contact address is not one of the addresses the page offers, so none is shown chosen
the user saves the page with nothing chosen, from either save control
the save is refused, with the error that a contact address must be selected shown in the error summary and against the options
the organisation's addresses are offered again with none chosen
the notification's contact address is unchanged

scenarios.heading: The page ends with Save and continue beside Save and return to hub, and Cancel and return to hub below them

steps.text: the user is on the contact address page
the page loads
it shows "Save and continue" and "Save and return to hub" side by side
it shows "Cancel and return to hub" on its own line below them

scenarios.heading: Save and return to hub with nothing chosen is refused the same way

steps.text: the user opened the contact address page, with no address chosen
they save and return to hub
the save is refused, with the error that a contact address must be selected shown in the error summary and against the options
the contact address page is shown again

scenarios.heading: An animal that still owes a permanent address has no row, while the species and roles-and-addresses cards are both still reported outstanding

steps.text: a cat line of two animals, with a permanent address saved for only one of them
the user views check-your-answers
the roles-and-addresses card lists a row for the answered animal alone
the error summary names both the species card and the roles-and-addresses card as needing to be completed

scenarios.heading: Answering every role marks the Overview task Completed when the page shows no CPH number or permanent address section

steps.text: the user has chosen an address for every party role on the consignment addresses page, and the page shows no CPH number or permanent address section
they return to Overview
the "Roles and addresses" task shows Completed

scenarios.heading: A line needing a permanent address with an animal identified holds the Overview task to To do until the animal has one

steps.text: every party role has an address, and an animal identified on a line that needs a permanent address has none
the user returns to Overview
the "Roles and addresses" task shows To do

scenarios.heading: The Overview task completes once every such animal has a permanent address

steps.text: every party role has an address, and every animal identified on a line that needs a permanent address has one
the user returns to Overview
the "Roles and addresses" task shows Completed

scenarios.heading: A consignment the page asks a CPH number of holds the Overview task to To do until the CPH number is given

steps.text: every party role has an address, and the notification has a commodity line the service treats as requiring a CPH number, with no CPH number saved
the user returns to Overview
the "Roles and addresses" task shows To do
it shows Completed once the CPH number is saved

scenarios.heading: A line needing a permanent address with no animal identified yet does not hold the Overview task back

steps.text: every party role has an address, and a commodity line that needs a permanent address carries an animal count but no animal identified
the user returns to Overview
the "Roles and addresses" task shows Completed

scenarios.heading: An address saved with no role is listed on every role's list and on the consignment contact page

steps.text: an address is saved with no role at all
the user opens any of the five consignment role lists, or the consignment contact page
the address is listed on all five, and on the consignment contact page

scenarios.heading: An address saved as a branch address is offered to the consignment contact and to none of the five consignment roles

steps.text: an address is saved as a branch address
the user opens the consignment contact page, or any of the five consignment role lists
the address is offered on the consignment contact page
the address is listed on none of the five consignment role lists

scenarios.heading: An address held for a consignment role is not offered here

steps.text: the organisation's address book holds an address for a consignment role, such as consignor, and a separate address held as a branch address
the user opens the contact address page
the address held for the consignment role is not offered as an option
the same address is offered on that role's own address list

scenarios.heading: An address held for a consignment role is refused the same way

steps.text: the user submits an address the book holds for a consignment role, not the contact role
they save and continue
the save is refused, an error links to and focuses the option group
no option is shown as chosen
nothing is saved

scenarios.heading: Contact address goes to check your answers whatever else is owed, once a contact address is chosen

steps.text: a notification with tasks outstanding and the contact address page open
the user chooses a contact address and saves and continues
check your answers is shown, naming what is outstanding
the contact address page open, with no contact address chosen
the user saves and continues
the save does not go on, and the contact address page is shown again

scenarios.heading: Choosing a contact address saves without error and is shown chosen on return

steps.text: the user is on the contact address page
they choose an address and save and continue
the answer is saved and no error summary is shown
they return to the contact address page
the page shows only the options and the save controls under its two headings, with the same address shown chosen in the list
they save and continue again
the chosen contact address is kept

scenarios.heading: Save and continue with nothing chosen is refused

steps.text: the user opened the contact address page, with no address chosen
they save and continue
the save is refused, with the error that a contact address must be selected shown in the error summary and against the options
the contact address page is shown again

scenarios.heading: A held contact address is kept when a save is refused

steps.text: the notification already holds a chosen contact address
the user saves the contact address page again with nothing chosen
the save is refused
the notification's contact address is unchanged

scenarios.heading: An invalid selection from the secondary save control is rejected the same way

steps.text: the user submits a value that is not one of the addresses offered on the contact address page
they save and return to hub
the save is refused, an error links to and focuses the option group
no option is shown as chosen

scenarios.heading: A saved county parish holding number reads in its slashed form

steps.text: a notification that needs a county parish holding number and has one saved
the user views check-your-answers
the roles-and-addresses card's county parish holding row reads "12/345/6789"

scenarios.heading: A saved CPH number shows in its slashed form with a Change link

steps.text: the notification has a saved county parish holding number
the user views the consignment addresses page
the CPH number section shows the number as "12/345/6789"
the section offers "Change" into the county parish holding number page as its one link

scenarios.heading: A commodity not on the list is not asked for a CPH number

steps.text: a notification whose only commodity line carries a commodity the CPH list does not name, such as ostriches
the user works through the journey
the County Parish Holding number is not asked for

scenarios.heading: The commodities that call for a CPH number are cattle, pigs, sheep, goats and poultry

steps.text: a notification with one commodity line
that line's commodity is cattle, pigs, sheep, goats, or poultry as day-old chicks, adult birds or hatching eggs
the County Parish Holding number is asked for, as a mandatory answer for the notification as a whole

scenarios.heading: Each box turns off the browser's saved values and asks for a digit keypad

steps.text: the user is on the CPH number page
they look at the county, parish and holding boxes
none of the three offers the browser's own saved values
a phone shows a digit keypad for each of the three

scenarios.heading: Saving every box empty is accepted and the section reads as incomplete

steps.text: the user is on the CPH number page with every box empty
they save and continue
no error is shown
the consignment addresses page's CPH section offers its add link again rather than showing a number

scenarios.heading: Saving every box empty clears a number saved before

steps.text: the user has saved a CPH number before
they empty every box and save and continue
the consignment addresses page's CPH section offers its add link again rather than showing the number that was saved

scenarios.heading: The review refuses to continue while the CPH number is missing

steps.text: a notification whose commodities call for a CPH number and whose CPH section has no number added
the user tries to continue from the review
the review refuses to continue, naming roles and addresses as outstanding

scenarios.heading: The help's second paragraph links to the GOV.UK guidance on checking a holding's details

steps.text: the user has opened the CPH number help
they read its second paragraph
it reads "You can find your CPH number on documents from the Animal and Plant Health Agency (APHA) or by checking your holding details on GOV.UK."
"checking your holding details on GOV.UK" links to the GOV.UK guidance on getting a county parish holding number, in the same tab

scenarios.heading: The back link returns to the consignment addresses page when the page was opened from Overview

steps.text: the user reached the CPH number page from Overview
they follow the back link
the consignment addresses page is shown

scenarios.heading: The back link returns to the consignment addresses page when the page was opened from a Change link

steps.text: the review of a draft notification
the user follows the Change link that opens the CPH number page and then the back link
the consignment addresses page is shown

scenarios.heading: Saving from the consignment addresses page's add link returns to it, showing the number

steps.text: the user opened the CPH number page from the consignment addresses page's 'Add a CPH number' link
they save a valid CPH number
the consignment addresses page is shown
the CPH section shows the number as "12/345/6789"

scenarios.heading: Saving from a review Change link also returns to the consignment addresses page

steps.text: the user opened the CPH number page from a review Change link
they save a valid CPH number
the consignment addresses page is shown

scenarios.heading: Saving from Overview also returns to the consignment addresses page

steps.text: the user opened the CPH number page from Overview
they save a valid CPH number
the consignment addresses page is shown

scenarios.heading: Saving while the country of origin is still missing opens the page that asks for it instead

steps.text: the user is on the CPH number page and the notification does not yet have a country of origin saved
they save a valid CPH number
the page asking for the country of origin is shown, not the consignment addresses page

scenarios.heading: Opening the page for a consignment that does not call for the number shows the consignment addresses page

steps.text: a notification whose commodities do not call for a CPH number
the user opens or submits the CPH number page by its own address
the consignment addresses page is shown instead
nothing is saved

scenarios.heading: The page with a "Same as …" control showing has no serious or critical accessibility violations

steps.text: the user has chosen an address for the place of origin and for the consignee, and no address for the consignor, importer or place of destination
the consignment addresses page loads at desktop width and at phone width
the page has no serious or critical accessibility violations

scenarios.heading: A section is filled from its paired party with JavaScript off

steps.text: the user has chosen an address for the place of origin and none for the consignor, with JavaScript off
they press "Same as place of origin" in the Consignor section
the Consignor section shows the place of origin's name and address lines

scenarios.heading: Only a section with no address whose source has one offers the control, and only for the three stated pairs

steps.text: the user has chosen an address for the place of origin and for the consignee, and no address for the consignor, importer or place of destination
they view the consignment addresses page
the Consignor section offers "Same as place of origin", and the Importer and Place of destination sections each offer "Same as consignee"
the Place of origin and Consignee sections offer no such control, and neither does the CPH number or permanent address section

scenarios.heading: Pressing the control fills the target section from the source, with no success banner, and the control is gone

steps.text: the Consignor section offers "Same as place of origin"
the user presses it
the consignment addresses page is shown again with no success banner
the Consignor section shows the place of origin's name and address lines, with "Change" and "Edit details" links, and no longer offers the control

scenarios.heading: The control fills the target even when the target's own address list would not offer that record

steps.text: the place of origin is an address-book record held only against the place-of-origin role
the user presses "Same as place of origin" in the Consignor section
the Consignor section shows that record's address
opening the consignor picker does not list that record

scenarios.heading: The filled party is an independent copy of the source

steps.text: the user has filled the Consignor section from the place of origin using the control
they change the place of origin to a different address
the Consignor section still shows the first address

scenarios.heading: The review shows the filled party's full details

steps.text: the user has filled the Importer section from the consignee using the control
they view the review
the importer's entry shows the consignee's name, address lines, country, phone number and email address

scenarios.heading: A request to fill a section the page is not offering changes nothing

steps.text: a section the page offers no "Same as …" control for, because the pair is not one of the three, because the source party has no address, or because the section already has one
a request arrives to fill it from that source
every answer is left as it was and the consignment addresses page is shown again

scenarios.heading: An address saved for one role is listed only on that role's list

steps.text: an address is saved for the consignee role alone
the user opens any of the five consignment role lists
the address is listed on the consignee list, and on none of the other four

scenarios.heading: An address saved for two roles is listed on both

steps.text: an address is saved for both the consignee and the importer roles
the user opens either role's list
the address is listed on both

scenarios.heading: The whole list is shown on one page

steps.text: a role's list holds more addresses than a page once held
the user opens that role's list
every one of them is shown, between the search box and the save controls, with the results heading and the count above the table

scenarios.heading: Clearing the search restores the role's whole list

steps.text: the user has searched the role's list
they clear the search and search again with nothing entered
the role's whole list is shown again

scenarios.heading: Back from View keeps the chosen address checked while changing an answer

steps.text: the address book service is available, and the user opened the list to change a role's address and chose an address
they follow an address's 'View' link and then select Back
the list is shown again with their chosen address still checked, and saving returns them where a change of answer does

scenarios.heading: Reopening the list shows the saved choice checked, and keeps it on save

steps.text: the user has chosen an address and saved it
they reopen the list to change it
the list shows that address's row checked
they save without choosing another
the role's row still shows the address they originally chose

scenarios.heading: Reopening the list shows no row checked once the address is edited here or deleted from the book

steps.text: the user has chosen an address and saved it
they have since edited its details on the notification, or the record has been deleted from the address book
they reopen the list to change it
the list opens with no row checked

scenarios.heading: A held contact address is not shown chosen once its record is no longer offered or its details were changed here

steps.text: the notification holds a contact address copied from a record the book no longer offers, or whose details were edited on the notification
the user opens the contact page
no address is shown as chosen
the notification keeps the contact address it holds

scenarios.heading: An invalid selection from Save and return to hub is rejected the same way

steps.text: the user has searched the address book and submits a value that is not one of the addresses offered
they select "Save and return to hub" and follow the error
the first address row is focused
the search term they entered is still in the search box

scenarios.heading: The page ends with Save and continue beside Save and return to hub, and Cancel and return to hub below them

steps.text: the user is on the contact page
the page loads
it shows "Save and continue" and "Save and return to hub" side by side
it shows "Cancel and return to hub" on its own line below them

scenarios.heading: Save and return to hub saves the address without continuing

steps.text: the user is on the contact page of a notification that is not being amended
they choose an address and select "Save and return to hub"
they reach Overview with the contact task Completed
returning to the page shows that address still chosen

scenarios.heading: A blank save and return to hub opens Overview with the task not yet started

steps.text: the user is on the contact page of a notification that is not being amended, with no address chosen and no contact address held yet
they select "Save and return to hub"
Overview is shown with no error summary
the contact task shows not yet started
returning to the page still shows no address chosen

scenarios.heading: An address shows its street lines, then its town, county and postcode on one line

steps.text: a listed address has two street lines, a town, a county and a postcode
the user finds it on a picker
each street line shows on its own line, then the town, county and postcode on one line

scenarios.heading: Blank parts are left out

steps.text: a listed address has no second street line and no county
it is shown on a picker
it shows its street line, then its town and postcode on one line, with no blank line

scenarios.heading: A row's disclosure shows only the record's telephone number and email address

steps.text: the user is on a picker
they open a row's "View details" disclosure
it opens in place, without leaving the page, and shows that record's telephone number then its email address
the record's name, address lines and country are read from the row's own columns, not the disclosure

scenarios.heading: The consignor picker lists only consignor-role and role-less addresses

steps.text: the organisation has an address saved for the place of destination role and an address saved with no role at all
the user opens the consignor picker
the role-less address is listed, and the place-of-destination address is not

scenarios.heading: The place of destination picker lists only its own role and role-less addresses

steps.text: the organisation has an address saved for the consignor role and an address saved with no role at all
the user opens the place of destination picker
the role-less address is listed, and the consignor address is not

scenarios.heading: The consignment contact picker lists every address, whatever its role

steps.text: the organisation has addresses saved for the consignor role, the place of destination role and no role at all
the user opens the consignment contact picker
all of them are listed

scenarios.heading: The picker shows its whole list on one page, with its count

steps.text: the user opens the picker
the page loads
every address the picker's list holds is shown
under the heading "Select an address" the page reads "Showing <total> out of <total> results"

scenarios.heading: Clearing the search restores the whole list

steps.text: the user has searched the picker's list
they clear the search and search again with nothing entered
the whole list is shown again

scenarios.heading: Reopening the picker shows the record the address was chosen from ticked

steps.text: the user has chosen an address and saved it
they reopen the picker
that record is ticked, with nothing restating it above the list

scenarios.heading: Reopening the picker shows no row checked once the record is deleted from the book

steps.text: the user has chosen an address and saved it
the record has since been deleted from the address book
they reopen the picker
no row is checked, and the current address card still shows the copy

scenarios.heading: Reopening the picker shows no row checked once the address is edited on the notification

steps.text: the user has chosen an address and saved it
they have since edited its details on the notification
they reopen the picker
no row is checked

scenarios.heading: The page shows every address on one page, none preselected

steps.text: the user has reached the contact page without answering it before
the page loads
it shows every address the organisation holds, reading "Showing <total> out of <total> results" under the heading "Select an address"
no address is shown as chosen, and the sentence saying whose address this is shows

scenarios.heading: A ticked row stays checked after a further search

steps.text: the user has ticked an address
they search again with a term that would not list that row
the ticked address is still checked

scenarios.heading: The page lists the organisation's consignor-role addresses, and any saved with no role, on one page

steps.text: the organisation has an address saved for the consignor role, an address saved with no role, and an address saved for the place of destination role
the user opens the consignor page
the consignor-role and role-less addresses are listed, on one page, and the place-of-destination address is not

scenarios.heading: The picker shows the role's whole list on one page, with its count

steps.text: the user opens the place of destination page
the page loads
every address the role's list holds is shown
under the heading "Select an address" the page reads "Showing <total> out of <total> results"

scenarios.heading: A search matching nothing says so, and clearing restores the list

steps.text: the user searches for a term matching no address
the results are shown
a message says nothing matched, not an empty table
they clear the search
the whole list is shown again

scenarios.heading: A germinal products add reaches the same add page as a live animals add

steps.text: a handshake naming the germinal products journey and one of its parties
the add page opens with it
it asks the same questions and offers the same controls as one reached from a live animals notification's party picker

scenarios.heading: Saving or cancelling a germinal products add returns to that notification's own return page

steps.text: a trader on the add page opened with a germinal products journey handshake
they save or cancel
they return to that germinal products notification's own return page, carrying the party, the token, the saved address and the landing each control names
never to a live animals notification

scenarios.heading: A germinal products add whose request also names a return of its own still returns to the registered germinal products pages

steps.text: a trader is on the add page opened with a germinal products journey handshake, and the request also names a return of its own
they save or cancel
they still return to the registered germinal products pages, not the request's own return

scenarios.heading: An address saved from a germinal products notification is the same record as one saved from live animals

steps.text: a trader fills in the add page opened with a germinal products journey handshake
they save it
it is stored with the same fields and the same role as one saved from a live animals notification

rows.title: The performance-test address book holds every role the plants pickers filter by
Role-filtered party pickers on one page
rows.gate: Look at role filtering on the compose stack and in stub mode, in both frontends, before the rows that rest on it build: a role-carrying record appears only on its roles' pickers, a record with no role appears on every picker, the list is one page, and the server search narrows it. The same-as row, the live filter row and the germinal set's copy of the pickers build on this.

High-risk plants pickers' address lines and trimmed details disclosure

The contact address page offers only the trader's own branch addresses and adds a new branch through the address book
The roles and addresses page shows a permanent address where one is needed, and its task completes only when every section shown does
The CPH, permanent address and contact pages' endings, with no cancel control while amending, and the contact page's hub wording
The address book takes adds from germinal products notifications and returns to them
Party and CPH number browser tests share the journey's save step and prove looks without class lists
Every save control on the county parish holding, permanent address and contact address pages makes the same checks
